description_en: Queries the policies that are created for an access configuration
description_zh: 查询访问配置中的权限策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso list-permission-policies-in-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --permission-policy-type System --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPermissionPoliciesInAccessConfiguration

parameters.description_en: The ID of the access configuration.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.description_en:
The type of the policy. The type can be used to filter policies. Valid values:

*   System: system policy.
*   Inline: inline policy.

If you do not specify this parameter, all types of policies are queried.
parameters.description_zh:
权限策略类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- System：系统策略。
- Inline：内置策略。

如不指定，则查询所有类型的权限策略。
